name: cpdev-template-authorization
title: Hide inactive authorization rows
taskDescription:
Summary: Hide inactive authorization rows from the member authorization search.
Overview: Users see inactive rows that should not be selectable in the React screen.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the search has inactive rows, when the user opens the grid, then inactive rows are hidden by default.
Technical Details: Update core-app AuthorizationSearchService and src/auth/search/AuthorizationGrid.tsx.
Testing Notes: Add unit tests for the filter and run the authorization search regression suite.
Out of Scope: Do not change export behavior.

name: cpdev-template-provider-search
title: Default provider search to active
taskDescription:
Summary: Provider search should default to active providers.
Overview: The ProviderSearchController currently returns inactive records when no status filter is selected.
Acceptance Criteria:
- AC: default search excludes inactive providers unless the user selects all statuses.
Technical Details: Touch provider-portal ProviderSearchService.java and ProviderSearchRequest.ts.
Testing Notes: Add request mapper tests and run provider search unit tests.
Out of Scope: Do not alter saved searches.

name: cpdev-template-dashboard-copy
title: Clarify retry button disabled text
taskDescription:
Summary: Clarify why retry is disabled on failed OneShot runs.
Overview: Operators cannot tell whether retry is blocked by max attempts or stage state.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a failed run used all retries, when the detail modal opens, then the retry button shows max attempts reached.
Technical Details: Update dashboard/src/oneshot/DetailModal.tsx and retry helper tests.
Testing Notes: Add React Testing Library coverage for disabled copy.
Out of Scope: No backend retry behavior change.

name: cpdev-template-fhir
title: Preserve FHIR profile metadata
taskDescription:
Summary: Preserve FHIR profile metadata when building DTR bundles.
Overview: The bundle mapper drops meta.profile values needed by downstream validation.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Verify that generated QuestionnaireResponse resources include the original profile array.
Technical Details: Update interop FhirBundleMapper.java and fixtures under src/test/resources/fhir.
Testing Notes: Run DTR mapper unit tests and fixture validation.
Out of Scope: Do not change PAS submission flow.

name: cpdev-template-sql
title: Fix report date filter
taskDescription:
Summary: Fix report date filtering for monthly claims report.
Overview: The SQL query includes records one day outside the requested range.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a monthly range, when the report runs, then only claims inside the range are returned.
Technical Details: Update reporting/monthly_claims.sql and ReportDateRangeService.
Testing Notes: Add SQL fixture coverage for boundary dates.
Out of Scope: Do not change report columns.

name: cpdev-template-queue
title: Retry queue stalled message
taskDescription:
Summary: Retry queue should expose stalled message diagnostics.
Overview: The worker queue hides the message group id when a planning job stalls.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Accepted when stalled queue entries show the MessageGroupId and retry stage.
Technical Details: Update OneShot queue dashboard service and QueuePanel.tsx.
Testing Notes: Add service unit tests and UI snapshot coverage.
Out of Scope: Do not change SQS retry policy.

name: cpdev-template-cost
title: Expose model cost source
taskDescription:
Summary: Expose whether OneShot cost is actual or estimated.
Overview: Operators need to know when a cost tile is derived from pricing fallback.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given mixed model telemetry, when the cost tab renders, then each model row labels actual, estimated, or mixed.
Technical Details: Update dashboard server costing helpers and CostAnalytics.tsx.
Testing Notes: Add dashboard server tests for mixed source rows.
Out of Scope: Do not alter billing export.

name: cpdev-template-routing
title: Add repo routing evidence
taskDescription:
Summary: Show repo routing evidence for qualifier decisions.
Overview: Operators need evidence when a ticket is sent to provider-portal instead of core-app.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a routed ticket, when the details modal opens, then matched repo evidence is visible.
Technical Details: Update RepoRouterDecisionMaterializer and dashboard route helpers.
Testing Notes: Add route service tests with two candidate repos.
Out of Scope: No router scoring changes.

name: cpdev-template-deployment
title: Show deployment superseded state
taskDescription:
Summary: Show superseded deployment records in OneShot detail.
Overview: A newer preview deployment hides why an older one stopped being active.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given a superseded deployment, when viewing run detail, then status and superseding commit are shown.
Technical Details: Update oneshotDeployments service and deployment summary component.
Testing Notes: Add dashboard tests for superseded records.
Out of Scope: Do not change ECS deploy behavior.

name: cpdev-template-ci
title: Surface required check state
taskDescription:
Summary: Surface required GitHub check state on PR-open runs.
Overview: OneShot can mark a PR complete while a required check is still pending.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Verify that required checks render as pending until GitHub reports success.
Technical Details: Update GitHub status polling and dashboard readiness evidence.
Testing Notes: Add mocked GitHub status tests.
Out of Scope: Do not auto-merge PRs.

name: freeform-clear-auth
title: Prevent inactive auth rows from default search
taskDescription: Users keep selecting inactive authorization rows by accident. The core-app authorization search service should exclude inactive rows unless the status filter explicitly includes them. Update AuthorizationSearchService and the React grid request mapper, then add unit coverage for default and all-status searches. Do not change exports.

name: freeform-clear-provider
title: Provider search active default
taskDescription: Provider search is returning inactive providers when no status is selected. Please make ProviderSearchService default to active records, wire the request mapper to send the explicit status, and add service plus mapper tests. The saved search behavior should remain unchanged.

name: freeform-clear-fhir
title: Keep FHIR profile on generated resources
taskDescription: The DTR bundle mapper drops meta.profile on QuestionnaireResponse resources. Update FhirBundleMapper in the interop service so generated resources keep the profile values from the source bundle, and add fixture validation tests that prove the profile array is preserved.

name: freeform-clear-dashboard
title: Explain disabled retry
taskDescription: Operators cannot tell why the retry action is disabled on a failed OneShot run. Update the dashboard DetailModal retry section to show whether max attempts were used or the stage is not retryable, and add React tests for both states. No backend retry behavior should change.

name: freeform-clear-queue
title: Show stalled queue message group
taskDescription: When OneShot planning stalls, the queue dashboard should expose the message group and retry stage so operators can match it to SQS. Update the queue service and panel component, then add server tests and a UI test for the stalled row.
